payload.title: Make opening saved sequences responsive without freezing large project
payload.description: Reproduce double-click Sequence freeze; profile switch UI/canonical transactions and derived work. Remove full-project work from scene switch hot path, preserve canonical state, undo and source transcript. Deploy and verify actual project switch responsiveness.
acceptance: Opening sequence does not synchronously rebuild/serialize all scenes/history or freeze UI
Canonical scene state and persistence remain correct; Main/transcription/seven sequences preserved
Regression and measured scene-switch evidence pass
Deploy production and verify real sequence switching
